params.name: limit
params.description: Entries per page. Observed honored (limit=1 and limit=2 both returned exactly that many entries and recalculated meta.last_page).

params.name: page
params.description: 1-indexed page number. Reflected in meta.current_page and the links object.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated sparse fieldset. Observed - `fields=title,slug` returned entry objects containing only `title` and `slug`.

params.name: sort
params.description: Comma-separated sort fields; a leading `-` reverses. Observed - `sort=-date` returned the most recent entry first.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of published Electra news entries. Observed 124 total entries on 2026-08-12. Anonymous request, HTTP 200, content-type application/json.

params.name: id
params.description: Entry UUID, as returned in `data[].id` from listNewsEntries.

items.docs: Returns one news entry by its Statamic UUID. Observed HTTP 200 for a known id.
